captions.text: Clean and arrange the wooden tiers of the altar in a quiet space in the home.
Place framed photographs of beloved family members and light glowing candles.
Lay down bright orange marigold flower petals to guide spirits with their scent.
Add traditional foods like sweet bread, fresh fruit, and water as offerings.
